why_this_one: The Dark Lord's second set, Adamantine (docs/plans/dark-lord-gear.md; OpenMU's rows, drop 57-78, lords only). The user, 2026-10-25: 'we need missing Dark lord items', 'do it'.
sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under MU's own names with an adamantine_ prefix, MU's _18 names being generic: dark violet-black plate trimmed in gold.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate, the shading painted on, as Light Plate.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, shallow for the gloss, as the other sets.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_ADAMANTINE_* (no glow, no chrome pass, no sprite; grep of MODEL_HELM..BOOTS + 26, docs/plans/dark-lord-gear.md).
